Player flinches only above a level threshold; recovery items skip 1-3 frames. Best transferable idea: keep the level-relative stagger lock and the palette-swap petrify, fix the hidden timer shift (explicit ticks in data). Half read: data and engine; multiplayer path not read. Stun is Lua with a repeating clean-up event (donor defect). Tints are averaged at a fixed blend ratio. Best transferable idea: one flag per debuff with a paired tint and icon, no stacking, expiry on the unit's own turn, and a poison floor. Half read: WML data and engine; server not read.
